task: On Allrecipes, find a vegan brownie recipe that has at least 40 reviews and a rating of 4.5 or higher. Include the list of ingredients, total prep and cook time, and a brief overview of the preparation steps.
answer:
Found a qualifying vegan brownie recipe on Allrecipes.

Recipe: Vegan Brownies
Rating: 4.6 (978 ratings — meets the ≥4.5 rating and ≥40 reviews requirements)
URL: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/68436/vegan-brownies/

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 cups granulated white sugar
- ¾ cup good-quality unsweetened cocoa powder, sifted
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- ¾ teaspoon salt
- 1 cup hot water or coffee
- ½ cup vegetable oil
- 2 teaspoons vanilla extract

Times:
- Prep Time: 15 mins
- Cook Time: 30 mins
- Additional Time: 10 mins
- Total Time: 55 mins
- Servings: 15

Preparation steps overview:
1. Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with baking spray; line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. Whisk flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt together in a large bowl until combined.
3. Pour in water (or coffee), vegetable oil, and vanilla; mix until well-blended. Spread batter evenly in the prepared dish.
4. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is no longer shiny and the center feels just set when gently pressed, about 30 minutes.
5. Let cool for at least 10 minutes before cutting into 15 squares.
